title: Hidden Grove
wikitext:
[[Image:The Hidden Grove.jpg|thumb|The Hidden Grove]]

'''The Hidden Grove''' is a forested crater in northeastern [[Winterspring]]. The grove is surrounded on all sides by high cliffs and is virtually inaccessible. There is one entrance through a cave on the southeastern face of the ridge {{coords|65.0|18.7|Winterspring}}. Dropping down from the top is also possible in some places, albeit very dangerous. The grove is home to many [[moonkin]] who are extremely hostile, and so most adventurers don't attempt to enter the glade.

{{Winterspring}}
